summary: Implemented the next visual-quality milestone for the existing GPU/AI infrastructure motion-graphics scene, reusing the milestone-1 engine (src/motion_graphics.py, src/create_poc_scene.py) rather than rewriting it. Added two reusable primitives to the engine: glow_composite() (a cheap downsample/blur/screen-blend bloom pass for rim-light glow on nodes and the final statement) and parallax_crop() (a background depth cue that drifts independently of the foreground zoom/pan). Applied them in the scene via a lower-third caption card treatment (soft card behind each caption for typographic hierarchy/legibility) and a per-node glow layer (request box, AI model box, each GPU box, modulated by its processing pulse). Rendered and validated a fresh output. First glow pass was overtuned (filled the boxes with fog and washed out the final statement); reduced radius/alpha and switched from filled ellipses to blurred box-outline rims before the final render.
